macros.name: alert
macros.doc: The given text is highlighted, typically by coloring the text red.

macros.name: bibitem
macros.doc: The ⟨citation text⟩ is inserted into the text when the item is cited using \cite{⟨label name⟩} in the main presentation text.

macros.name: framesubtitle
macros.doc: If present, a subtitle will be shown in a smaller font below the main title.

macros.name: insertdescriptionitem
macros.doc: \insertdescriptionitem inserts the text of the current description item.

macros.name: insertenumlabel
macros.doc: \insertenumlabel inserts the current number of the top-level enumeration (as an Arabic number).

macros.name: insertframetitle
macros.doc: \insertframetitle yields the frame title. • \insertframesubtitle yields the frame subtitle.

macros.name: structure
macros.doc: The given text is marked as part of the structure, that is, it is supposed to help the audience see the structure of your presentation.

envs.name: abstract
envs.doc: You can use this environment to typeset an abstract.

envs.name: alertblock
envs.doc: Inserts a block whose title is highlighting.

envs.name: exampleblock
envs.doc: Inserts a block that is supposed to be an example.

envs.name: quote
envs.doc: Use this environment to typeset a single-paragraph quotation.

envs.name: verse
envs.doc: You can use this environment to typeset a verse.
